summary: Phase 2a R1 gate BLOCKED before any file edit: no natural decreasing measure (Sigma 3^complexity over unexpanded compound occurrences, or a subformula-replacement multiset measure) survives the world-creating F(phi->psi) rule, because propagatePersistence (Rules.lean:139-141) unconditionally duplicates ALL T-formulas at the parent world -- including already-expanded compounds -- onto the fresh world, unbounded by complexity(phi->psi). No def, sorry, axiom, or placeholder was introduced; Scheme.lean is untouched and remains at baseline commit 26508fe9. Phase 1 (B2 none-case) remains complete and committed.

blockers.description: Neither plan-proposed measure candidate (Sigma 3^complexity over unexpanded compound occurrences; multiset measure replacing a compound by strictly-smaller subformulas) strictly decreases (or is even non-increasing) on the F(phi->psi) world-creating rule. intFImpRule (Rules.lean:154-159) emits T(phi)@w', F(psi)@w' (output complexity = complexity(phi->psi)-1, matches the classical identity from classicalApplyOne_output_complexity) PLUS propagatePersistence b w w' (Rules.lean:139-141), which copies EVERY T-signed formula at world w -- unconditionally, including compounds already marked expanded at w (per the (sign,formula,label)-triple equality used by intStepBranch's `expanded` set, Expansion.lean:150-157) -- to fresh labels at w'. These copies are NOT subformulas of phi->psi and are not bounded by complexity(phi->psi); they are bounded only by the ambient complexity of whatever T-formulas already accumulated at w. applyAllTImpRules/applyPersistenceFixpoint (Expansion.lean:118-139, run before intStepBranch each iteration) only handle T(phi->psi) modus-ponens propagation -- they do not pre-reduce compound T(and)/T(or) formulas at w, so a compound can legitimately still be sitting unexpanded at w (order-dependent via List.findSome?) when F(->) fires and gets duplicated. Net per-step change in raw unexpanded-complexity = -1 + (sum of copied compound complexities), which is positive whenever any compound is copied. The classical 3^x exponential trick cannot rescue this because it only works for a branching split (2*3^(c-1) < 3^c); F(->) is a .linearResult (Expansion.lean IntRuleResult), not a .branchingResult, so there is no branching-factor discount available. This is a genuine termination-argument gap: the algorithm DOES terminate (via a finite-model/bounded-worlds argument implicit in the 2^(2*complexity+2) fuel bound), but no simple per-step-decreasing Nat measure over raw branch contents captures it, because the same compound formula can be legitimately re-introduced at a new (larger) world label and must be re-expanded there.
blockers.next_action: dedicated measure-design research spike -- candidate directions: (a) measure over the finite subformula x world closure (bound worlds a priori, measure 'closure slots not yet settled' rather than raw branch occurrences); (b) lexicographic/product measure with 'remaining world-creation budget' as primary decreasing component and per-world complexity as tie-breaker; (c) investigate whether propagatePersistence could be soundness-preservingly restricted to avoid duplicating already-fully-discharged compounds (this would require editing Rules.lean/Expansion.lean semantics with its own correctness argument -- out of this plan's Scheme.lean-only territory as currently scoped, would need a plan revision).
